title: Geometric Perspective on Concentration Phenomena in Frame Theory
summary: Parseval and equal-norm frames play a fundamental role in frame theory and signal processing. It is known that a random frame, with unit vectors drawn independently from the uniform distribution on the sphere, will be nearly Parseval with high probability; asymptotic results go back at least to Goyal, Vetterli, and Thao and a non-asymptotic error bound was proved more recently by Kwok, Lau, and Ramachandran.
